title: Correlated whole-line derivatives isolate one stationary candidate and certify the fixed-q two-radius global minimizer
scope_guard: The complete Bernstein bank first excludes fourteen stationary leaves. Four local correlated point/hull jets and exact closed-box subdivisions exclude the other thirty-seven candidate leaves, while the leaf50 necessary-root bounding rectangle has positive Hessian throughout. K1787 gives existence there. Together with the accepted outer sublevel, first-two-slab, value and boundary certificates, this proves one global minimizer in the fixed q=1/1024 two-radius scalar chart. Higher stationary points in value-excluded regions are not ruled out. This is not an optimizer over all channel laws, a GU action, a physical state, a prediction, a confirmation or canon promotion.
